screenconnect-cleanup.name: v1.8.13-beta.1 - Latest Beta - reviewed cleanup and GUI
screenconnect-cleanup.body_html:
BETA release and the new Latest download used by install-latest.ps1.

Promotes the GUI Alpha 10 runtime, which passed hosted Windows CI, with no runtime code changes in this version promotion. Earlier releases remain available.

Included behavior:

  • Reviewed cleanup repairs and unchecked persistence-candidate selection checkboxes with typed REMOVE confirmation.
  • Offline offers staged KVRT only; ESET and Malwarebytes installation remain Online-only.
  • Clear Online continuation, separate-scan and cancellation choices.
  • Fresh locked folders for each Online attempt, preserving Offline evidence and earlier scanner/persistence results and reports.
  • Combined reports use the current Online evidence. Failed report generation prevents uploading an older or partial report.
  • Current Online summary, report button and Desktop copy; explicit logging when antivirus scans are skipped.

Extract the complete ZIP and open the top-level START-HERE-GUI.bat. The existing installer command now downloads this beta as Latest.

Validation: Alpha 10 hosted Windows CI completed successfully (https://github.com/pupontech/screenconnect-cleanup/actions/runs/44087136061). Local Alpha 10 checks included 106 stubbed GUI window assertions, 62 GUI/batch parity assertions, launcher and repeated-run/report-failure regressions, and real report generation/persistence WhatIf fixtures. Beta runtime bytes were compared to the tested Alpha 10 code; the beta ZIP passed integrity, manifest, exact source-byte, version and provenance checks, and its GUI self-test passed. No live removal or vendor antivirus scan was performed. Live elevated Windows acceptance remains outstanding.

This build is labeled BETA. It is published as a regular GitHub release so GitHub Latest and the installer can select it.
